overview: The Medford School Committee approved updates to its CTE admissions policy, recognized MHS Science Fair awardees, and discussed constraints facing the 2026–2027 school calendar. The committee also reviewed proposed revisions to its operating rules.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills and payrolls, donations, a quarterly update, and prior meeting minutes.

items.title: Mustang Moment: MHS Science Fair Recognition
items.summary: Recognized award winners and student presenters from the annual Medford High School Science Fair.

items.title: CTE Program Admissions Policy Revisions
items.summary: Approved Department of Elementary and Secondary Education requested language updates to the Chapter 74 CTE admissions lottery policy.

items.title: FY 2026–2027 School Calendar Review
items.summary: Discussed scheduling constraints and holiday observances for the upcoming school year, with plans to gather union and community feedback before proposing calendar updates.

items.title: Term Objectives Summary Review
items.summary: Tabled the review of the committee's term objectives summary from its January retreat.

items.title: School Committee Rules Review
items.summary: Reviewed proposed revisions to the committee's operating rules and voted to consolidate the edits for presentation at the next meeting.
